editorial.blurb: Klay Oven Kitchen serves approachable, homestyle Indian food with genuinely kind service and excellent value—a standout in the food hall.
editorial.insiderTip: Grab the mango lassi to round out your meal, and come at lunch for a quick bite between meetings; the vegetarian options (rajma masala, masala dosa, aloo gobi wrap) are particularly plentiful.
